categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, specifically declaring determinations of land ownership for multiple parcels of land in various locations. It contains detailed land particulars including parcel numbers, extents, owner information, and land classifications. The content falls squarely within the definition of Land Gazettes as it concerns land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements without any government personnel changes or structural administrative modifications.
